description: One dish or drink on the restaurant's menu. The menu page groups items by section and sorts them by order.

id.label: ID
id.help: Generated from the name. No need to change it.

name.label: Name
name.help: The dish as it appears on the menu, e.g. Wood-fired Margherita.

section.label: Menu Section
section.help: Which part of the menu the item belongs to. The menu page shows sections in this order.

price.label: Price
price.help: Price in the restaurant's currency, without the symbol.

description.label: Description
description.help: One or two plain sentences: the main ingredients and what makes it good. No formatting.

dietary.label: Dietary
dietary.help: Tick everything that applies. Each one shows as a small badge next to the dish.

image.label: Photo
image.help: Optional photo of the dish. Featured items show it on the home page; landscape works best.

featured.label: Featured
featured.help: Turn on to show this dish on the home page. Three or four featured items look best.

order.label: Order
order.help: Position within its section. Lower numbers come first.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the item is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the item is created.
